## Summary / 變更摘要

Describe the problem and the change. Link a related issue if one exists.

## User impact / 使用者影響

Explain any change to installation, Skill behavior, MCP input/output, editable objects, or PowerPoint compatibility.

## Checks performed / 已執行檢查

List the checks you actually ran and their results. If a relevant check was not run, say why. For PPTX changes, distinguish package validation, visual review, and PowerPoint save/reopen verification.

## Privacy and documentation / 隱私與文件

- [ ] Examples, screenshots, logs, and test files contain no private user material, credentials, or personal paths.
- [ ] Documentation and Skill instructions were updated where behavior or setup changed, or this PR explains why no update is needed.
- [ ] I have read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/junyi0111/MarpPPT/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/junyi0111/MarpPPT/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
